What exactly is vibroacoustic therapy?

Vibroacoustic therapy is a wellness technique that uses sound and vibration to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and support overall health. It's based on the principle that specific frequencies can positively influence our body's cells and systems.

How does the V.I.B.E. System work?

The V.I.B.E. System (Vibrational Individual Body Enhancement) combines precisely calibrated sounds and vibrations to create a full-body therapeutic experience. As you lie on the bed, it transmits Specialized music programs called Sonic-ceuticals™️ frequencies through your entire body, helping to balance your system and promote wellness.

Sonic-ceutcals™️ combine 5 to 7 layers of frequencies, sacred geometry, mathematical ratios, and natural energetic signatures to directly influence and optimize a variety of physiological effects like PTSD, ADD/ ADHD, Depression/ Anxiety, Chronic and acute inflammation, stem cell activation, wound healing, tissue regeneration, sports recovery, addiction recovery and future timeline alignment.

What is vibroacoustic therapy?

Vibroacoustic therapy is a wellness technique that uses sound and vibration to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and support overall health. It's based on the principle that specific frequencies can positively influence our body's cells and systems.

How does the V.I.B.E. System work?

The V.I.B.E. System combines precisely calibrated sounds and vibrations to create a full-body therapeutic experience. As you lie on the bed, it transmits Specialized music programs called sonic-ceuticals frequencies through your entire body, helping to balance your system and promote wellness.

Can I try the Vibe?

Yes you can go to our Vibe Locator page and find vibe owners nearby

https://bioharmonictechnologies.com/pages/find-your-vibe

What are Sonic-ceuticals™?

Specialized Audio programs designed by our founder, Dr Steven Schwartz

Sonic-ceutcals combine 5 to 7 layers of frequencies, sacred geometry, mathematical ratios, and natural energetic signatures to directly influence and optimize a variety of physiological effects like PTSD, ADD/ ADHD, Depression/ Anxiety, Chronic and acute inflammation, stem cell activation, wound healing, tissue regeneration, sports recovery, addiction recovery and future timeline alignment.

Why do transducers matter in the V.I.B.E. System?

Transducers are the components that convert electrical signals into physical vibrations. High-definition transducers, like those in our system, ensure that the therapeutic frequencies are delivered with precision and clarity, maximizing the benefits of each session.

What kind of results can I expect from using the V.I.B.E. System?

Users often report reduced stress, improved sleep quality, decreased pain, enhanced focus, and a general sense of well-being. However, individual results may vary. Consistent use over time typically yields the best results.

What's the difference between the V.I.B.E. Pro and V.I.B.E. Go systems?

The V.I.B.E. Pro is our full-size, professional-grade system ideal for clinics and wellness centers. It offers 4 transducers and a premium surround sound system. The V.I.B.E. Go is our compact, portable solution with 2 transducers and high-fidelity stereo sound, perfect for home use or mobile practitioners.

Is it safe for pregnancy?

Yes It's safe during pregnancy. Make sure to keep the vibration and sound low. Do not use cell cleanser with pregnant women. It may dump toxins through the placenta.

How does the VIBE affect pregnancy? Is it safe?

The VIBE system is generally considered safe during pregnancy, but there are some precautions to consider. It is recommended not to use the Cell Cleanser audio track during pregnancy. Additionally, both the vibration and audio levels should be adjusted to the comfort of the mother and baby. Lowering the intensity ensures a gentle and comfortable experience for both the mother and the developing baby.

 

For any specific concerns, always consult with a healthcare professional before using vibroacoustic therapy during pregnancy.

How often should I use the V.I.B.E. System?

The frequency of use can vary depending on your wellness goals. Many users find benefits with 2-3 sessions per week, but some enjoy daily sessions. We recommend starting with shorter, less frequent sessions and gradually increasing as you become comfortable with the therapy.

Is there a warranty on the V.I.B.E. System?

Yes, all V.I.B.E. Systems come with a 3-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Extended warranty options are available for purchase.

What makes Bioharmonic Technologies different from other vibroacoustic therapy providers?

Bioharmonic Technologies stands out due to our commitment to quality, innovation, and user experience. Our systems offer superior frequency delivery, High-definition sound and vibration, and a user-friendly interface.

 

Bioharmonic Technologies and the VIBE System was created by a doctor specializing in reversing chronic illness and human optimization since 2000.

Dr Steven Schwartz has been formulating sonic-ceutcals since 2007 and has been directly involved in the Vibroacoustic industry since 2012.

Do you offer financing options?

Yes, we partner with several financing providers to offer flexible payment plans. You can select your preferred financing option during checkout.

How long does shipping take?

Standard shipping within the continental US takes 5-7 business days. Expedited shipping options are available at checkout. For international orders, shipping times may vary.

Is professional installation available?

Yes, we offer professional installation services for an additional fee. This is recommended for the V.I.B.E. Pro system or custom installations. The V.I.B.E. Go is designed for easy self-setup.

Bioharmonic Technologies Return and Refund Policy

At Bioharmonic Technologies, we are committed to ensuring customer satisfaction. Please carefully review the following terms and conditions regarding returns, refunds, and shipping policies. By purchasing from our store, you agree to these terms.

 

Returns

We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for eligible products. If you are not 100% satisfied with your purchase, you may return the item for a refund, subject to the following conditions:

  • Shipping costs are non-refundable.
  • To initiate a return, you must:
    1. Ensure the item is in its original condition and packaging.
    2. Provide a receipt or proof of purchase.
    3. Contact us at this link to receive return instructions.

Important Notes on Returns

  • Non-refundable Items:
    • Items marked as non-refundable are not eligible for refunds under any circumstances.
  • Shipping Costs for Returns:
    • If the customer paid for shipping and wishes to return an item within 30 days, they may use our warehouse return service to drop off the item back to our warehouse at no additional cost.
    • If the customer opts for a refund, the original shipping cost will be deducted from the refunded amount.
    • Customers may choose to return the item using their own shipping service; however, they are responsible for all associated shipping costs.
  • Condition of Returned Items:
    • As per our inspection policy, Each product will go under inspection process to check Items that are not in their original condition, are damaged, or are missing parts due to reasons not attributable to Bioharmonic Technologies may only qualify for partial refunds.
  • Timeframe for Returns:
    • Items returned more than 30 days after delivery are not eligible for refunds.

 

Returns for Damaged Goods

If your product arrives damaged, you must:

  1. Report the damage within 24 hours of receipt.
  2. Provide clear pictures and videos of the damaged goods and packaging to this link.

Important Notes on Damaged Goods:

  • Refunds for damaged goods will be issued minus shipping costs.
  • Claims for damaged goods without accompanying pictures or videos will be considered ineligible for a refund.

Damaged or Defective Merchandise

If your product arrives damaged or has a mechanical issue, contact us within 48 hours of discovering the issue. We will work with you to resolve the problem promptly.

Non-returnable Items

The following items are not eligible for return:

  • Downloadable software products.
  • Items marked as FINAL SALE.

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you via email regarding the approval or rejection of your refund. If approved, your refund will be processed, and a credit will be applied to your original method of payment. Refunds may take up to 30 business days to process.

  • Late or Missing Refunds:
    1. Check your bank account.
    2. Contact your credit card company, as processing times may vary.
    3. Contact your bank for additional information.
      If you’ve completed these steps and still haven’t received your refund, contact us at this link.
  • Credit/Debit Card Fee or any method transaction fee will be deducted from Refund.
  • There will be restocking fee of $250 for each Vibe which includes our repacking and inspection cost.
  • Customer will pay return cost, or he/she can deliver to our warehouse.

Sale Items

Only regular-priced items are eligible for refunds. Discounted or promotional items are not eligible.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. To request an exchange, contact us atthis link.

Shipping

  • Shipping Guidelines for Returns:
    • Customers are responsible for paying return shipping costs unless using our warehouse return service within the 30-day return window.
    • Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the original shipping cost will be deducted.
  • Heavy and Specialized Products:
    • Due to the size and weight of certain products, such as the VIBE systems, all returns must be sent directly to our warehouse. Refunds will only be processed after receipt and inspection of the item at the designated warehouse address.
  • Recommended Practices:
    • Use a trackable shipping service and purchase shipping insurance. We cannot guarantee receipt of returned items without these precautions.
